login.headline: Every riyal accounted for, from funding to invoice
login.subheadline: One workspace for petty cash: funding, agent allocations, invoices, approvals and reports.

files.title: Every invoice kept with its original file
files.body: PDFs and photos are stored permanently, so any figure can be traced back to the paper behind it.

balance.title: Each agent sees their own balance
balance.body: Allocated, spent, pending and remaining cash at a glance, with no spreadsheets sent around.

approval.title: Approved before it is recorded
approval.body: An expense controller reviews every invoice, and only approved amounts reach the consumption history.
